data.name: Containment Director
data.detailed_description:
What is Containment Director?
In this top down base building simulation game, you will build and manage a secret government organization that contains all the things that go bump in the night. In order to keep the monsters satiated you'll have to creatively design environments that match the monster's preferences so they feel right at home. Additionally, your staff will look to you on how to schedule their daily routines to ensure the success of the base and their safety... Will you be able to keep the monsters contained?

Features:

  • Fully 3D characters and environments,

  • Up to 4,000 characters (between staff & monsters) supported running performantly,

  • At least 20 Floors to work with on a vertical layer (Build deep underground or a Containment Facility skyscraper!),

  • 3 Main Staff Archetypes (Engineer, Scientist, Security),

  • Monsters that have containment difficulties that scale with the 0-3 security levels

data.short_description: You are the Director of a secret government organization that contains all the things that go bump in the night. From tall brutalist towers to hidden underground bunkers, design and build your personalized horror monster containment facility.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), 8.1, or 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-2300 or AMD FX-4300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 560 (2GB) or AMD Radeon 7850 (2GB)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.14 (Mojave) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video Card (AMD): Radeon R9 M290 | Video Card (NVIDIA): GeForce GTX 775M
